title: Nuclear Madness: MV Ramana in Conversation w/ Joshua Frank
author: CounterPunch.org
content:
In this episode of CounterPunch Radio, MV Ramana speaks with Joshua Frank
about the lies and misconceptions surrounding a nuclear power revival, atomic
energy's ties to weapons proliferation, and much more. The conversation took
place in January at [Page Against the Machine](https://www.patmbooks.com/)
bookstore in Long Beach, California.

M. V. Ramana is the [Simons Chair in Disarmament, Global and Human
Security](https://sppga.ubc.ca/profile/m-v-ramana/) at the School of Public
Policy and Global Affairs, University of British Columbia, and the author of
[Nuclear is Not the
Solution](https://www.versobooks.com/products/3013-nuclear-is-not-the-
solution) with Verso Books.

Joshua Frank is co-editor of CounterPunch and co-host of [CounterPunch
Radio](https://www.counterpunch.org/category/counterpunch-radio-podcasts/). He
is the author of [Atomic Days: The Untold Story of the Most Toxic Place in
America](https://www.haymarketbooks.org/books/1940-atomic-days), and the
forthcoming, [Bad Energy: The AI Hucksters, Rogue Lithium Extractors, and Wind
Industrialists Who are Selling Off Our
Future](https://bookshop.org/p/books/bad-energy-the-deep-sea-miners-rogue-
lithium-extractors-and-wind-industrialists-who-are-selling-off-our-future-
joshua-frank/6613ae4e8b79415e?ean=9798888906071&next=t&next=t&affiliate=1039),
both with Haymarket Books.
